facts.title: fire on TX-7001 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on TX-7001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-7001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on TX-7001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 26 October 2024 an incident occurred on TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
